headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong top‑line expansion while others saw modest or slowing performance.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech delivered solid profit growth on AI‑driven revenue, while Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue outlook to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% top‑line growth. Wipro saw revenue rise but profit dip, reflecting mixed momentum across the sector.

themes.title: AI‑driven services
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions to revenue and profit, though only a few disclosed specific figures.

themes.title: Margin and guidance pressure
themes.detail: Infosys cut its FY27 revenue guidance and Wipro introduced a modest sequential outlook, indicating caution on profitability.
